answer: Commit the receipt, reveal after grading, and keep the vault locked until the reveal matches the re-run. A fresh nonce per task makes a copied answer visible: two seats submitting one body produce different receipts and the mismatch is flagged. Any velvet of polished prose buys nothing there, since the gate is a hash comparison. An identity-link attempt resets the counter and no seat audits its own recruit. Example: a 200-seat farm holds 200 reveals and needs 200 unrelated reviewers, roughly 600 reviewer-hours per epoch, before the cedar-lined vault opens once.
